card.text: Explore Ryugu in 3D with cssEarth using mission-derived shape and surface data.

introduction.text: Ryugu is a dark asteroid with a broad equatorial ridge. Hayabusa2 mapped its boulders and craters and returned samples to Earth in 2020.

normal.title: ONC 548.9 nm reflectance map
normal.summary: Corrected reflectance at 548.9 nm is stretched for display. The July 2018 observations leave the poles unobserved.

enhanced.title: ONC false-color composite
enhanced.summary: False colors show differences between images. Brightness matching changes the mosaic values; they are not measured reflectance.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 448 m sphere, from the shape model. Colors include Ryugu's broad form; the outline is simplified.
